question.text: In evaluating the 'Investment Management Team and Infrastructure' dimension of fund DD, the Manager's LP-facing pack should demonstrate:

answer.text: Only the CV of the Managing Partner — since other team members are fungible.
Team skill-set, analytical resources (macro/equity/credit), organisational structure, staffing adequacy and compensation structure.
Only the Chief Investment Officer's IRR track-record from prior roles.
Only the number of CFA charterholders on staff, as SEBI requires a minimum count.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Ch 12 lists the IM team DD as covering team quality, analytical support (macro/equity/credit), organisational structure, staffing adequacy and compensation — all four are inspected together. **The Trap:** A, C ignore team depth — a key LP concern. D is fabricated — SEBI has no CFA headcount rule (it requires key-person qualifications under Reg 4(g)). **Cross-Exam Context:** Compensation structure inspection is NEW in XIX-C vs distributor exams. It maps to ILPA's 'compensation alignment' principle — LPs dig into base/bonus/carry splits to detect 'carry-heavy-junior' retention risks. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Prepare an org chart with 'tenure at firm' annotations for each key person. LPs will red-flag if senior investment team members have <2 years with the firm.
